plan.title: AD lesional vs control DE + hallmark GSEA (Python)
plan.analytical_narrative:
The input is a single-batch bulk RNA-seq count matrix from Salmon (12,000 gene symbols x 12 samples) with an unpaired 6 lesional vs 6 control design in human skin. The research question has two parts — which genes change, and which hallmark pathways change — plus an explicit data-quality flag: sample_01 has a library size ~4x below the median. Everything is written in Python per the user constraint, so PyDESeq2 replaces DESeq2 and gseapy/decoupler replace fgsea/clusterProfiler.

Track 1 handles the shallow-library concern before it can distort the contrast. T1S1 quantifies library sizes, DESeq2 median-of-ratios size factors, and sample-sample relationships (PCA on VST-transformed counts, correlation heatmap, RLE) to decide empirically whether sample_01 is merely shallow (low depth, normal profile — keep, since the negative binomial model with size factors handles depth) or an outlier in profile (systematically distorted — then it must be down-weighted or excluded). That decision is made from evidence, not asserted. T1S2 then runs the primary DESeq2 contrast lesional vs control on all 12 samples, and, critically, re-runs the identical contrast with sample_01 excluded (n=5 vs 6) as a sensitivity analysis — the overlap of the two DE gene sets is the honest measure of how much the shallow sample drives any result. The full-12 fit is primary unless T1S1 showed profile-level distortion; either way both are reported side by side.

Track 2 takes the DE result to pathways. T2S1 runs hallmark GSEA on the full shrunken-LFC-ranked gene list (not a thresholded gene set), which is the right test at n=6 per group where per-gene power is limited, and repeats it on the sensitivity ranking so that any hallmark claim can be checked against sample_01's influence. A per-sample hallmark score (ssGSEA/decoupler on normalized counts) is added so pathway calls can be inspected sample-by-sample rather than only as a group summary — this also makes sample_01's position in pathway space visible.

Caveats carried throughout: n=6 vs 6 unpaired with a single batch gives modest power and no way to separate biological from technical variation beyond depth; the matrix is 12,000 symbols, i.e. already filtered or a subset, so hallmark set coverage must be reported rather than assumed complete; and 'treated' here means AD lesional skin, an observational disease-vs-control contrast, not a drug intervention, so nothing causal follows.

Explicit statement of which fit is primary and why, referencing T1S1's verdict
Overlap statistics between A and B DE sets, plus Spearman correlation of their shrunken log2FCs
Volcano plot and top-DE-gene heatmap saved, sample_01 annotated in the heatmap
p-value histogram and dispersion plot saved and commented on
Named top up- and down-regulated genes with their log2FC and padj
caveats: With 6 vs 6 the FDR set can be small or empty — report that plainly rather than loosening thresholds to manufacture hits
Genes appearing only in fit B may be power artefacts, not new biology; do not present them as discoveries
Shrunken LFCs are for ranking and visualization; use unshrunken stats for the significance call, and say which is which

steps.name: Hallmark GSEA and per-sample hallmark scoring
steps.question: Which of the 50 MSigDB hallmark pathways are coordinately shifted in AD lesional versus control skin, and are those calls robust to the shallow sample_01?
steps.description: Run pre-ranked gene set enrichment against the human hallmark collection (MSigDB hallmark gene sets for Homo sapiens, HGNC symbols, 50 sets — resolve the reference from the environment's pathway resources; the human hallmark GMT, not the mouse one) using gseapy prerank on the shrunken-log2FC ranking from T1S2. Do this for BOTH rankings: fit A (all 12 samples, primary) and fit B (sample_01 excluded), then report which hallmarks are significant in both, in one only, and how their NES values agree. Use 1000+ permutations, min set size 10, max 500, and report for each hallmark the NES, nominal p, FDR q, leading-edge genes, and the number of set members actually present in the 12,000-symbol matrix — coverage must be reported because the matrix is a subset and low overlap makes an NES unreliable. Separately, compute per-sample hallmark activity scores from the VST/normalized matrix (gseapy ssgsea or decoupler enrichment scoring) and plot a sample-by-hallmark heatmap annotated by condition with sample_01 marked, so pathway shifts can be inspected sample-wise rather than only as a group statistic. Report the top enriched hallmarks in both directions with their leading-edge genes, and state whether AD-expected biology (inflammatory response, interferon, complement, allograft-rejection-type immune signatures, keratinocyte proliferation) appears — without forcing the narrative if it does not.
steps.context: Downstream of the DESeq2 contrast. The hallmark collection is 50 broad, coherent biological states; it is the right granularity for a two-group disease-vs-control skin contrast at n=6. Ranked GSEA is preferred over over-representation of a thresholded list because per-gene power at n=6 is limited.
constraints: Python only — gseapy and/or decoupler; no clusterProfiler, no fgsea, no R
Use the HUMAN hallmark gene sets (Homo sapiens, HGNC symbols) — the dataset is human skin; using the mouse collection is a hard error
Run prerank on the full ranked gene list from T1S2, not on a thresholded DE subset
Run the enrichment on BOTH the fit A and fit B rankings and compare
Report per-hallmark set coverage (members found / set size) alongside every NES
Set a fixed random seed so permutation results are reproducible
acceptance_criteria: Hallmark GSEA result tables for both the all-12 and sample_01-excluded rankings, with NES, p, FDR q, leading edge and set coverage
Explicit list of hallmarks significant at FDR<0.25 (and separately FDR<0.05) in both rankings versus one only
Per-sample hallmark score heatmap saved, annotated by condition with sample_01 marked
Named top hallmarks in each direction with leading-edge genes

If the hallmark reference is unavailable at run time, the step reports that explicitly and falls back to the human GO biological process collection, stating the substitution — it must not silently use a different organism
caveats: The 12,000-symbol matrix is a subset of the transcriptome; hallmark sets with poor coverage give NES values that should not be interpreted
GSEA FDR q<0.25 is exploratory by convention — label it as such, do not present it as significance
Hallmark sets overlap in membership; several correlated hits are not several independent findings
ssGSEA scores are within-cohort relative values and are not comparable to any external dataset
